packageRules.description: No workflow runs on renovate/* branches, so branch automerge would wait forever on a pending branch status. Merge without tests; the push run on master regenerates the README.
No workflow runs on renovate/* branches, so branch automerge would wait forever on a pending branch status. Merge without tests; the push run on master regenerates the README.

Renovate appends Maven Central to every Maven dependency regardless of the repositories declared in the poms, and a 429 from Central raises an ExternalHostError that can abort the run. Pinning each groupId to the registry that actually serves it keeps Central out of the lookup path.
